Dialogs.Dialog: Take it to the staff room. Within a week.
Sure, I don't mind. I'm heading that way anyway.
Thanks. I don't want to go anywhere near the staff room.
Do it yourself, ▲小早川＊▲. It's your errand, isn't it？
(I need to hand in ▲小早川＊▲'s notebook... Where's the teacher？)
So you took it in for me.
Yeah, the one you asked me about. Handed it right to the teacher.
(Not even a thank-you, huh... She's still pretty cold.)
How come you didn't take it in？
Uh... I just couldn't find the right time...
Hey, do my library duty for me.
I don't really mind, but... why？
No way, I'm not doing that.
(Come to think of it, ▲小早川＊▲ asked me to cover her duty...)
You actually covered my duty for me.
(Pretty sure that's where you're supposed to say thanks...)
You skipped out on library duty, didn't you？ Even though I asked you to cover for me.
I just got chewed out by the teacher because of that.
(Well, I guess it's my fault for breaking my promise...)
Here. Have the overdue list done in three days.
No way I can do that
Well, I figure it's good practice for learning the committee work.
There's no way I can do that on such short notice.
Like you've got anything better to do...
(It's not like I'm totally free, though...)
(Come to think of it, ▲小早川＊▲ asked me to make that overdue list...)
(I still need to make that list ▲小早川＊▲ asked for...)
Oh, you actually finished the overdue list.
Yeah, though I really had to scramble.
You didn't even finish the overdue list.
Yeah... I kind of ran out of time...
Hey, what's that？ What kind of music do you listen to, ▲小早川＊▲？
...Never mind. You wouldn't know it even if I told you.
Maybe I'd know it if I heard it？
...Sigh. Maybe if I feel like it. Try asking me again sometime.
Got it, let me listen next time. It's a promise.
I'm not making any promises, but... do whatever you want.
Well, if you don't feel like it right now, never mind.
(Right, wasn't ▲小早川＊▲ going to let me listen to her music...？)
(▲小早川＊▲ didn't let me listen to her music...)
Take my time looking for her
Sigh... Do you really want to hear it that badly？
I'm just kind of curious, that's all.
I guess I don't mind, but... Here.
(...She seems kind of happy about that, though... Maybe I'm imagining things.)
And you never even showed up.
Nothing. It's not like I wanted to force you to listen anyway, so whatever.
By the way, isn't Library Week starting soon？
Yeah. So don't slack off on your committee duties.
Pretty sure I'm not on duty...
I know, you don't have to tell me.
Haha, just leave it to me.
Where's all that confidence coming from？ Makes no sense.
Pretty sure I'm not on duty during that week...
...So while I'm busy working, you're just gonna slack off by yourself.
(What am I supposed to say to that...)
(It's Library Week... I should get to my committee duties.)
(Still Library Week, huh... Guess I'll go do my committee duties.)
Taking my time should be fine
Library Week's finally over, huh. Good work to you too, ▲小早川＊▲.
I didn't really do enough work to get tired, though.
Really？ Well, it did go smoother than I expected.
...Because someone I'd written off as dead weight turned out to be surprisingly useful.
A newbie who doesn't even do his job is the worst.
A bit late to be apologizing now.
I'm so sleepy... Hey, just for a week, text me every morning to wake me up.
Sure, sounds fun. Will a text really be enough to wake you up, though？
Why me...? Wouldn't it be faster to just have your family wake you up？
(？ Is she in a bad mood？ )
(Come to think of it, ▲小早川＊▲ asked me to wake her up with a text.)
(Oh right, I need to text ▲小早川＊▲...)
Thanks to your meddling, I might've managed not to oversleep.
For now, I'll just say thanks.
For a busybody... you're pretty useless, you know. You never even texted me.
Ah, right, this morning... Sorry about that.
Whatever. I wasn't counting on you to begin with.
Oh, right. Apparently the library committee's holding meetings to improve operations for a while.
Improve operations？ Sounds kind of overblown.
Agreed, but they said attendance is mandatory.
Got it. Guess I have no choice.
I don't think I can make it
I see. Well, guess we don't have a choice.
It's part of our duties on the committee. Don't skip out.
I've got some things going on... I don't think I can make it.
So you're just gonna pretend you're busy. What a cop-out.
(Come to think of it, wasn't there a library committee meeting on improving operations...？)
(Right, I've got that library committee meeting on improving operations...)
Taking my time should be fine
Look at you, perfect attendance at the meetings.
Yeah, well. Anyway, what was that even about？
Who knows. Probably just a whim of the teacher's. What a pain.
Why didn't you come to the library committee meetings？
Uh... Well, a lot came up, you know？
Having people absent put the teacher in a bad mood, and the rest of us had to deal with it.
Hey, ▲小早川＊▲, do you go straight home after school？
Hmm. If you don't trust me, want to tag along？
I'm free, so maybe I will
Nah, it's not that big a deal
Maybe I will, since I'm free.
I wasn't being serious, you know.
Oh, come on. If you don't want me to, don't offer in the first place.
I didn't say you couldn't... I don't really mind.
All right, guess I'll do that for a while.
(Doesn't seem like she's actually against it...)
Never mind, it's fine. I'm not that curious anyway.
What the heck... Talk about half-hearted.
(Come to think of it, I said I'd walk home with ▲小早川＊▲... Wonder where she is.)
(Guess I'll walk home with ▲小早川＊▲ again today... Wonder where she is.)
Of course not. Just relieved is all.
I told you, you don't need to worry about me. We're good now, right？ Later.
Weren't you supposed to tag along with me after school？
Oh, right... Well, something came up.
(Maybe I should've done like I said I would...)
There are quite a few overdue books.
...Think we should go around and collect them？
We don't need to go that far
Tracking them all down looks like a lot of work, though.
Might have to split it up over a few days.
I don't think we need to go that far...
(Oh right, we're supposed to collect those overdue books... Wonder where ▲小早川＊▲ is.)
(Time to collect overdue books again today... Wonder where ▲小早川＊▲ is.)
We actually got back more than I expected.
A lot of people had the books on them, they just couldn't be bothered to drop them off.
If you borrow something, you return it. It's basic common sense. Anyway, good work today.
Were you seriously planning on making me collect them all by myself？
Oh, the overdue books... No, that's not it...
So you're all talk and zero responsibility, then.
Still going to the arcade lately？ People are gonna worry if you stay out late.
Shut up... I get enough lectures from the teachers.
If you're so worried, why don't you come keep an eye on me yourself？
All right, I'll hold you to that. I'm really gonna show up, you know.
Uh, I guess that'd be pretty annoying, huh.
Then I'll just drop in and say hi. I won't get in your way.
You sure are a weird one.
No way, I wouldn't go that far. Then I really would be acting like a teacher.
(？ She seems a little disappointed for some reason...)
(I wonder if ▲小早川＊▲'s at the arcade again today... Maybe I'll go check on her.)
(Wonder if ▲小早川＊▲'s at the arcade today too... Guess I'll go check on her.)
You sure keep coming back. You can stop now, you know.
Yeah, I guess. Doesn't look like it's all that dangerous around here anyway.
I told you, you worry way too much. Such a busybody.
Come on, don't be like that. Just be careful, okay？
You never even showed up at the arcade.
Not that I care. It would've just been annoying if you did show up.
Hey, being on library duty is mostly just sitting around anyway. Wanna have a contest to see who can read more books while working？
A contest, huh？ All right, I'm not gonna lose!
Hehe, you think you can beat me that easily？
Come on... We're supposed to be working, not goofing off.
Yeah, yeah, look at Mr. Serious over here.
Pretty sure that's just called being normal... probably.
(Oh yeah, ▲小早川＊▲ and I were gonna see who could read the most books... What should I read？)
(I'm in the middle of that reading contest with ▲小早川＊▲... What should I read？)
Yeah, well... still not as much as you, ▲小早川＊▲.
Well, y'know, that's the difference between a pro and an amateur.
It means you did pretty good for an amateur. Anyway, it was a good way to kill time.
How much did you manage to read？
That's pathetic. Less than a tenth of what I read.
(Well, only by slacking off on work...)
I found three kittens behind the school building. Didn't see the mother anywhere, though... Wonder if they moved in？
Wait, really？ Then I'll look for someone to adopt them, so let's take care of them together until then.
Yeah, good idea. We can't just leave them there.
It's settled! I'll come get you every morning starting tomorrow, so let's bring milk and food for them.
Got it. What kind of food should we bring？
You've got canned mackerel on you, don't you？
I don't think that's good for cats...
It was a joke, obviously. Anyway, that's the plan.
(Is it just me, or is she really excited？)
Hmm... If we do that, we're just gonna get attached to them...
Well, yeah, maybe, but... Fine, forget it.
(Right, I'm supposed to take care of the kittens with ▲小早川＊▲...)
(Taking care of the kittens with ▲小早川＊▲ again today, huh...)
I found a home for the kittens.
I see, glad you found it.
It was a lot of work, you know.
Thanks for doing all that. Aren't you gonna miss them, though, ▲小早川＊▲？
Well... a little. But what's best for the kittens comes first.
The kittens behind the school... They're gone...
What...? Think someone took them in？
(Maybe I should've kept a better eye on them...)
When people ask what a library book is about, it's pretty hard to explain on the spot, isn't it？
Then how about we put little summary cards on the books people ask about a lot？
Right？ Well, good luck with that.
What do you mean, "good luck"...? We're doing it together, aren't we？
Because it was your idea in the first place.
All right, let's do this together!
That sounds like a pain in its own right...
Then why don't you figure something out yourself？
(She was just trying to help... Maybe I shouldn't have said that.)
(Come to think of it, ▲小早川＊▲ mentioned making summary cards for the library books...)
(Guess I'll work on those summary cards again today...)
Look at that, the summary cards are done. They actually turned out pretty good.
Yeah, all thanks to you, ▲小早川＊▲.
You worked pretty hard yourself, didn't you？ Hehe.
This should make things easier for the people borrowing them, too.
I wonder why we didn't have these before. The past library committees weren't very thoughtful.
Wait, were you planning on dumping all the summary card work on me from the very beginning？
Then actually help me out already.
Hey, you know those little promo signs they always have in bookstores？
Yeah, some of them are pretty elaborate.
I wonder if we could do something like that for the library committee.
Could be fun. Let's try making some.
Then it's settled. I'm not accepting any compromises, so be ready.
Hmm, I feel like that might be going a bit overboard.
(Come to think of it, ▲小早川＊▲ mentioned making promo signs for the books...)
(All right, guess I'll work on those promo signs again today...)
Good work. They turned out looking pretty nice.
Good work to you too, ▲小早川＊▲. I think everyone's going to like these.
They're just as good as anything you'd see in a real store.
All thanks to my good taste, haha.
Huh？ What are you talking about？
(Maybe I got a little carried away... Still, I'm glad we did this.)
They look kind of half-baked and lame...
(She's right... It really is my fault...)
How have things been with your family lately？
Never mind that, are you free for a while？ Could you hang out with me a bit at night...？
My dad said he'll be able to come home early at night for a while. For once.
Then shouldn't you spend time with your family...？
Well, yeah, maybe. I just figured the two of them need some time alone.
My little brother's one thing, but if I'm around, they'll probably feel awkward.
That's how it is. Anyway, as long as we can kill some time at the park or wherever, it's fine.
You think I'm always free, don't you, ▲小早川＊▲？ That's not always true.
Oh, really... Fine, then I won't ask you.
(Huh...？ Why is she getting so mad？)
(Come to think of it, ▲小早川＊▲ asked me to hang out with her at night...)
(Maybe I'll hang out with ▲小早川＊▲ again tonight...)
Thanks for hanging out with me.
Thanks to you, things are going great with those two.
Still... I wonder if they even realize I'm doing this for them.
You never showed up... I ended up having to kill time all by myself.
Yeah, it is. Don't make promises you can't keep in the first place.
(...Maybe I'll try calling her something different. Last name, first name, with -san, with -chan...)
(She turned me down, but I wonder if calling her that was okay.)
(...Did she just ignore me？ Maybe I shouldn't have called her that.)
Why？ ...I mean, I don't really care.
You don't mind？ Alright, let's go.
（Looks like that name worked after all.）
(...Maybe I shouldn't have called her that.)
Since we're both here, let's go together.
（Looks like that name worked after all.）
Since we're both here, wanna walk together？
What's 'since we're both here' supposed to mean...？ Tag along if you want.
（Looks like that name worked after all.）
By yourself？ Let's walk together if you don't mind.
With me？ Hehe, sure, I guess.
（Looks like that name worked after all.）
（It's ▲高嶺＊＊▲... Maybe I'll talk to her.）
You startled me... Oh, it's just ▲小早川＊▲.
（It's ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲... Maybe I'll talk to her.）
Sorry, there's someone I needed to talk to...
Oh, really. Not that I care...
Sorry, I was just about to go talk to ▲高嶺＊＊▲.
Hmm... Guess I'm in the way, then. Whatever...
Sorry, I was just about to go talk to ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
Oh, right. I actually needed to see you, ▲小早川＊▲...
What？ You could've just said so sooner.
Yeah, that's the book! That's a load off my mind.
Oh, good for you. ...Well, I'm heading out.
（I wonder if ▲高嶺＊＊▲ is still around？）
（I wonder if ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ is still around？）
（She looks like she's in a bad mood...）
Do you need something？ I'm kind of in a hurry.
Oh, okay... See you later, then.
You caught me off guard, that's all... Anyway, I gotta go.
（Oh, there's ▲高嶺＊＊▲... Maybe I'll say hi.）
What's with that reaction...？ Way to kill the mood.
（Oh, there's ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲... Maybe I'll say hi.）
I was just about to go talk to someone I know.
I see... Sorry for getting in the way. Bye.
Actually, I needed to see ▲高嶺＊＊▲ about something...
So it's not me you need... Sorry to bother you. Bye.
Actually, I needed to see ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ about something...
Oh, good timing. I had something to ask ▲小早川＊▲.
...Really？ Well, I suppose I can hear you out.
I see... I can always count on you, ▲小早川＊▲.
Don't go relying on someone younger than you. Anyway, I'm leaving.
Don't you have someone else to talk to right now？ ...Bye.
I kind of need to get going.
I'm not exactly free either, you know.
(There's ▲高嶺＊＊▲... Should I go talk to her？)
(There's ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲... Should I go talk to her？)
If you don't need anything, I'm gonna head out. I've got someone I need to see.
"Not really"...？ Well, I've got someone to see, so I'm heading out.
...Why don't you hurry up and go？
"Not really"...？ Oh, right. I actually needed to ask you something, ▲小早川＊▲.
Oh, I see. Glad I asked you, ▲小早川＊▲.
(Right, I was gonna go talk to ▲高嶺＊＊▲...)
(Right, I was gonna go talk to ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲...)
(She just clicked her tongue at me...)
What？ You took forever, so now I'm out of time.
(Wait, was she waiting for me...？ Nah, couldn't be.)
Well, I'm gonna head out, then.
(What was that about？ ...Looks like ▲高嶺＊＊▲ is gone too.)
(What was that about？ ...Looks like ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ is gone too.)
(▲高嶺＊＊▲... Wonder what she's up to？)
Whoa, you startled me... You were here, ▲小早川＊▲？
I've been here this whole time...
I didn't notice you... What's up？ I was actually on my way to see someone, though.
Fine, sorry to bother you. Bye.
Did you need something？ I have someone I need to talk to...
...As if I'd ever need anything from you. Idiot.
Good timing. I actually needed to see you, ▲小早川＊▲.
What is it？ Make it quick.
Okay, I get it now. That makes sense.
(Probably no point looking for her now...)
It's not like I was waiting for you... I'm leaving. Bye.
Sorry, I didn't see you there. Anyway, I'm in a hurry, so I gotta go.
Are you okay？ Did you get hurt...？
I'm not hurt... You just startled me.
Really？ Don't just tough it out, okay？
What am I, a kid？ Bye.
Sorry! Anyway, I'm in a rush, so I gotta go.
Well... I'm fine. I'm in a hurry.
...I'm fine. Anyway... I'm in a hurry.
Go on, shouldn't you get going？
I'm in a bit of a hurry. Gotta go.
(▲小早川＊▲ actually has a pretty nice face, huh...)
Isn't that normal for you？ Bye.
Hey, it's not like I'm spacing out all the time.
Oh... I was spacing out. What were we talking about？
Never mind... I have to get going...
Hmm, got time to kill, huh？ Bye.
Not much, nothing in particular really.
Got an errand to run. See ya.
...Oh, my bad. Did I hold you up？
...Oh, sorry. Did I get in your way？
It's fine. Not like I'm busy or anything.
What's up？ Did you need something from me？
No, I won't get bored of you.
What's up？ Don't tell me you had business with me.
Would you rather I did have business with you？
Anyway, I've got somewhere I need to be.
(▲小早川＊▲ really has a certain vibe about her...)
...Oh, I was spacing out. Did you need something？
...Oh, sorry. I spaced out. Did you need something？
Sort of, but... forget it. See ya.
Do I have something on my face or what？
Listen... Aren't you embarrassed at all？
What's with this distance between us...
Why are you standing so far away？
Aren't you staring a bit much？ Not that I mind, it's just...
When you go quiet like that... I don't know what to do...
What... Trying to get closer to me or something？
You don't have to stand so far away... you know.
Just a little closer... you know...
(Maybe I was a little too forward...)
(My heart was racing for some reason...)
Well, I'd expect at least that much.
That much should be a breeze, right？
Huh... Well, I guess that's no big surprise.
I see... So you're actually pretty good？
Heh, looks like you're pretty capable.
What's done is done. It can't be helped.
Moping around about it will only make things worse.
It's fine. It's nothing to get that worked up over.
Well, I guess that makes sense...
There's no helping this one, is there？
I could cheer you up... if you want.
Stop moping already. It can't be helped.
Not that it's any of my business...
Not that I care, but... what are you gonna do？
Hmm... So, what're you gonna do？
Well？ What are you gonna do about it？
Hey, what are you going to do？
Well, not that I really care.
Well, let's see what you've got.
Huh. Just try not to mess it up.
Heh, show me what you can do.
I don't really care either way...
Oh, come on. That's a little disappointing.
How's the tennis club, anyway？ Is it actually fun？
Yeah, I'd say so. Our club isn't all that strict, so it's fun.
Are you interested, ▲小早川＊▲？ That's kind of surprising...
I hate exercising. I was just a little curious.
...Well, the guys and girls there seem to get along pretty well.
You know, mingling like that... Don't you have something going on too？
Hard to say... I don't think there's really anything like that going on with me, though...
Is your part-time job tough？ Or is it fun？
Are you interested, ▲小早川＊▲？ I wonder if we're hiring right now...
That's not what I meant. Don't go jumping to conclusions.
I'm asking whether you're enjoying it or not.
I'd say it's fun... though it can be a pain sometimes.
Hmm... So are there a lot of girls working at family restaurants？
Yeah. I don't know about other places, but we do have quite a few.
Nothing. Sounds like you're having a great time!
Does your class get along pretty well？
Hard to say... I think we get along okay, though.
Well, you transferred in mid-year. I just wondered if you were fitting in.
Haha, things aren't so bad that I need ▲小早川＊▲ worrying about me.
What's that supposed to mean？ That's kind of hurtful.
I'm actually fitting in pretty well with my class now, you know.
Want to come check on me if you're worried, big brother？
(Looks like ▲小早川＊▲ is doing well, too...)
I was just wondering about something.
What's it like living on your own？
Yeah？ Want to come see for yourself？
Nothing. Aren't you the one getting weird ideas here？
Inviting a helpless underclassman to your room and all...
Huh？ No, you've got it wrong, I was just—!
Hehe, look at you panic. I'm just kidding.
Visiting an upperclassman's place does sound kind of fun, though.
...It's not really a big deal, or anything.
There's a girl in the tennis club you're pretty close with, right？
I heard there's an upperclassman at your job you're pretty close with.
Hmm. So you really are close with her？
Still, I'm... pretty close with you too... right？
I mean, we talk. If anything, I'm probably closer with you, ▲小早川＊▲.
Huh？ ...Hmm, I see... Is that right.
Can I ask you one thing？
You're pretty close with a girl on the tennis team, right？
I heard you're pretty close with an upperclassman at work.
I knew it... Are you two really that close？
Do you talk to her more than you talk to me？
Yeah. I probably talk to you more, ▲小早川＊▲.
There's something I've been wondering about.
You're close with a girl on the tennis team, right？
You're close with an upperclassman at work, right？
If her name comes up right away... you really must be close.
It does. You're close with me too, aren't you？
It's not that we don't get along, I just hang out with you more, ▲小早川＊▲. Like right now.
When you're with me... how is it for you？
Well, when I'm around you, I feel like I can take it pretty easy...
Like you can relax around me？
Yeah, like that. I was just wondering how it is for you.
I just felt like stopping you for a second.
Hey... Can I ask you something weird？
Don't you think I've gotten... a little more girly lately？
Um, if you don't think so, that's fine.
I've just been trying a little harder myself, is all... Hehe.
(A used bookstore, huh... Wonder if they have anything good...)
I knew it was ▲小早川＊▲. Hey.
What are you doing in a place like this？
Just browsing around... Oh, right, I'm on the library committee, remember! I came to appreciate some books.
Same here. There's a book I'm looking for. They have a good selection here.
If you're interested, I can explain it to you.
And even in an era like that, they set themselves apart from the Beat Generation writers...
What, do you have a question？
Um, we've been here a pretty long time, so how about we save it for later？ Even the clerk's smiling awkwardly at us.
What？ I haven't even gotten to the best part yet.
I'll hear the rest during committee duty next time. You know, like proper library committee members.
It's been a while since I talked that much to someone. You kind of have... a knack for that. You're easy to talk to.
Yeah... That was fun. See you.
(▲小早川＊▲ sure talks a lot when it's about something she likes...)
(A music store, huh... They've got all kinds of stuff...)
Hey, what a coincidence. Did you need something at a music store？
It's not like I needed anything...
Oh right, ▲小早川＊▲, you're always listening to music. Do you play an instrument yourself？
...Well, I used to play a little guitar.
Um... I don't know if I'd say I can play, exactly... I guess？
That's awesome. Play something for me.
All right, it's all tuned up for you. Here you go.
No, I'm, like, checking the weight of the guitar and how the neck feels in my hand.
Whoa, you really know your stuff...
All right, thank you very much.
Huh, you can tell just from that.
(She seemed kind of flustered... Did I do something wrong...？)
（Well then... Maybe I should head home soon...）
I was just kind of spacing out.
Haha, what's that about？ Even you have moments like that, ▲小早川＊▲.
What's wrong with that？ It's nice to just take it easy sometimes.
Yeah, maybe. Looks kind of nice, actually, so I'll join you.
Join me？ I'm not doing anything, you know.
Come on, let me space out too.
I wonder why. I feel so relaxed next to you.
Yeah？ I think I feel the same way when I'm with you, ▲小早川＊▲.
You really are like a big brother.
Well, I am a year older.
There's the age thing, sure... but that's not all it is.
It's because you're you that you feel like a big brother.
It's fine if you don't get it.
Rinko has to go now. Bye-bye.
（All right, time for another day of library duty...）
Seriously, can you believe her attitude？
I know, right？ Ugh, it ticks me off so much!
（Don't tell me that's about ▲小早川＊▲ again...）
Hey, did you get into an argument with someone？
Sorry if I'm wrong, but... I had a feeling.
I'm in a bad mood right now. Don't talk to me.
In a bad mood... So something really did happen, huh？
...Those stupid girls were messing with their phones in the library. Beeping away without even putting them on silent.
I did. Got a problem with that？
What did you say to them？
I told them idiots who don't even have basic manners shouldn't use school facilities. And while I was at it, that their makeup sucks and doesn't suit them at all.
That's going a little too far...
What's your deal？ Taking those stupid girls' side too？
